rules: Same ratchet-down-only policy as the live site's tool/page-budget.json (see its 'rules' field): any PR that reduces exampleSite page weight must lower maxPageBytes (or a tightened override, or maxCssBundleBytes) in the same PR — reclaimed bytes are banked, never slack. Home has NO override — it must fit the default budget for real. Ratchet history: Task 13 first trimmed home from 137,669/138,334 B to under 135,000 B (pricing teaser simplified to a plans-only summary, redundant <title> fixed), then narrowing fraunces-roman.woff2 (wght axis + opsz pinned per the typography owner's verdict — see tool/subset_fonts.sh) dropped every page ~29 KB and funded the 135,000 → 123,000 ratchet (~15% over the heaviest regular page, same margin methodology as the live site's own baseline+15%). The per-page-kind CSS split was later removed as an architecture smell (page-oriented styling): the single cached main.css bundle costs every page ~7.7 KB more on FIRST load in exchange for zero per-navigation CSS and a page-agnostic section/component architecture. Product-owner ruling 2026-07-26: the default HOLDS at 123,000 (heaviest regular page 113,839 B, 8% headroom) — recalibrating it up would hand undetected drift to the 60 pages that pass; instead, exactly two structurally atypical page KINDS carry overrides (the one-page styleguide and the image-bearing product pages). Overrides are page-kind-scoped, never per-page escape hatches: a third candidate means the default is wrong or the page is doing too much — escalate to the product-owner, do not add a line. maxCssBundleBytes hard-caps the built sass/main.min.*.css: under single-bundle architecture every CSS byte multiplies across all 64 pages, so bundle growth is gated at its named cause instead of surfacing as scattered page-budget breaches (same hard-max pattern as the font gates in tool/subset_fonts.sh). Revisit triggers: the styleguide override dies if the component library is ever split across routes; the notably override is contingent on current image encoding — a screenshot re-encode tripping 125,000 is deliberate, not a flaky gate. All six numbers ratchet-down-only from the merge commit forward.

/styleguide/.justification: The template's deliberate kitchen-sink demo: the entire component library, including the permanent contact-form demo, on ONE page by design. Contingent on the styleguide staying a single page (product-owner ruling 2026-07-26).

/fr-fr/styleguide/.justification: Same as /styleguide/, FR copy — EN/FR delta is translation noise, never encoded in the numbers.

/products/notably/.justification: Product detail page renders a real product screenshot via the figure pipeline (AVIF/WebP/srcset) — image-bearing by design, per the ratchet policy. 120,000 → 125,000 with the single-bundle restructure (+~7.7 KB/page site-wide); relative headroom TIGHTENED versus mechanically preserving the old margin (product-owner ruling 2026-07-26).
